# simplify way to remove submodule

Make removing a git submodule a single command. The canonical procedure (the linked [Stack Overflow answer](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/1260748/how-do-i-remove-a-submodule)) is `git submodule deinit -f <path>`, `rm -rf .git/modules/<path>`, `git rm -f <path>`, and cleaning the `.gitmodules` section — four steps easy to get half-done. Part of the "Git flow" milestone.
